powersafegrid.tooltip.relay.1: Breaks the load circuit when the voltage leaves the configured range.
powersafegrid.tooltip.relay.2: Right-click to configure. Reconnects automatically when the voltage returns; overcurrent latches it off.
powersafegrid.tooltip.stabilizer.1: Keeps the output at %s V while the input is inside the working window.
powersafegrid.tooltip.stabilizer.2: Working window: %s-%s V. Outside the window it shuts down and latches off.
powersafegrid.tooltip.stabilizer.3: Over 60 A it smokes and switches off, at 100 A it explodes.
powersafegrid.tooltip.reset: Reset a tripped device with Create's wrench (or a screwdriver).
powersafegrid.gui.relay.hint: Drag the handles or scroll on them.
powersafegrid.goggles.reset_hint: Reset with a screwdriver/wrench to re-enable
powersafegrid.goggles.stabilizer.status_: Status: input voltage out of window
powersafegrid.tooltip.creative_stabilize: Creative stabilizer: outputs a constant %s V.
Ignores the input entirely - no voltage window, no current limit, never trips.
Ideal source: it can also absorb power fed into its output.
powersafegrid.tooltip.auto_stabilizer.1: Automatically resets ~3 s after the voltage returns to normal.
powersafegrid.tooltip.inverter.1: Converts up to %s V input to 0-100 %% of it. Adjust with the wrench scroll box on the back.
powersafegrid.tooltip.inverter.2: Forms a 2x2x2 cube from 8 blocks. Wires attach to the assembled cube's faces.
powersafegrid.tooltip.inverter.3: Overcurrent: %s A trips with smoke, %s A explodes.
